name: Petersen Step-Up
instructions: Stand side-on on a low step with your working foot flat. Let your other leg hang off the side of the step.
Lift the heel of your working foot and push your knee forward over your toes. Keep the weight on the ball of your foot.
At the same time, lower your free heel until it touches the floor lightly. Do not put weight on it.
Drive your working heel back down onto the step as you straighten your knee and lift your free leg.
Finish standing tall on a flat working foot. Do all the repetitions, then change sides.
